Definition: from G2837; sleeping, i.e. (by implication) repose:--taking of rest.
BiblicalUsage: Koimesis is taking of rest in sleep. John 11:13 explains that Jesus spake of Lazarus's death, but the disciples thought He had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the misunderstanding is the point: the disciples heard rest, and Jesus meant death, because for His friend the two were the same.
